notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/04ca870572a78b78d50d88efb5a0af13dbcb978c.png

Here comes a new patch! We've made a few fixes, most importantly - fixed the issue with Steam invites. You can now enjoy smooth Shroom-crushing in multiplayer 😉

Have a great weekend, everyone!

MCE Version 1.1.1 - October 9th, 2020

Adjustments:

Trinket #54’s 1st positive was granted a wish, and got 1 extra range
Fine tuned a few more Unique Trinket descriptions

Fixes:

Steam invites should be back in working order!
Trinket #27 and #29’s positives actually do something again!
Trinket #50’s second positive is longer shy about making a sound when it heals
Trinket #51’s second positive no longer works selectively in levels with Palshrooms, Skeletons, and Mad Squirrels
Trinket #55’s second positive has been taught to be a bit more thorough with its effect removal process
Enemies now properly only become able to take damage and conditions after they have completed their spawning process
Previously, some slimes refused to blink when destroyed, so they got lectured, and now they do!
The “Knock Knock!“ Accomplishment now has the correct icon
The “Mid Five!” Accomplishment no longer awards 2 Trinket slots. Those who got the extra one get to keep it though ;)
Pop-ups in the Trinket Forge no longer allow navigating outside the intended buttons

notes.title: Feature Update: Trinket Forge
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/6e52547ee2a94d2a6314326eef1556990d5a42c7.png

Is it mushroom season already? With the evil Shrooms popping up all over the place once again, we have prepared a new feature to ease your fight—Trinket Forge, as well as a few other things. Let’s dive in!

Are you tired of carrying around all your Trinkets? With the new MCE Trinket Forge, you can merge and upgrade your Plain trinkets, to pack more power into your loadout. You can combine the best of two different Trinkets into one or boost up a single Trinket’s stats. For extra fun, you can switch up your Trinkets’ shapes, colors and names. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/abf4b84fc8272fe53746aa7ff40de0588a83651e.png

For good measure, we have thrown in a whole new Unique Trinket—Treasure of the Earth. When equipped, it allows you to summon the powers of Earth itself and relocate level tiles for your convenience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/66e27cbd4a27bf47cb8894e3bc533a61640f74b8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/312bb19f6735828f3fc6e97427b616cc18fdbce8.gif

See the full notes on the update in our dedicated Steam forum thread.

As much as we’ve enjoyed working on MCE, after nine years, it is time we move on to pastures new. As the game has finally fulfilled our vision of it, this may be the final update we make. Even so, we welcome all new players to join and achieve new heights in Shroom crushing! 

Last but not the least, for the upcoming weekend Mushroom Crusher Extreme is 90% off on Steam. If you don’t already own a copy or just have a friend you’d like to crush some Shrooms with in multiplayer—don’t miss this chance!

 We’ll also be running a competition on Discord community tomorrow—the winner gets two free copies of MCE and some other goodies. Drop on by to see more details: https://discord.gg/teamjollyroger.

Have fun Trinket forging and keep on crushin’!

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 1.00.3
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/12e3d4bd1a6c241d6de82f11db7b9d335fab3cb0.png

Heya! It's finally time for another patch! This time we have fixes for a couple of bad issues, along with some less pressing ones. Hopefully, more don't pop up, so that we can focus on... more interesting things.

MCE Version 1.00.3 - July 17th, 2019

Adjustments:

Trinket #52’s positive specials and first negative special now activate as a spell cast completes, not when being charged by Trinket #48’s second positive special


Fixes:

Addressed some save data corruption issues, hopefully minimizing their frequency
Controller analogue sticks now work again
Screen shake is also back in working condition
Screen whitening no longer persists when going back to the menu in the middle of it
Enemies that produce light can no longer leave them behind when defeated
Palshroom shots no longer go haywire when their shooter becomes dizzy
Thunderstorm joltings' lights are now properly vertically centered
Deep Freeze isn’t stopped by boxes anymore, and it also doesn’t go inside of them when used with Trinket #8
Trinket #27’s counter no longer counts down the whole time a spell is being charged by Trinket #48’s second positive special
Trinket #43's second positive special now activates from all bosses
Trinket #45's first negative displays its message again
Trinket #48 no longer causes total mayhem when paired with Trinket #39

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 1.00.2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/eafacb62718638ceeda9a8e57d8bfd5b75ac7ed7.png

It's a patch! Here are a few fixes and adjustments we've prepared this week.

MCE Version 1.00.2 - June 17th, 2019

Adjustments:

Lowered the damage penalty of some levels


Fixes:

Spells should no longer go through Palshrooms at random
Fixed a bug which made it so that Trinkets’ basic affixes weren’t sometimes applied in online co-op
Plain Trinket sell price now updates when moving the selection with the sub-menu open
Charmed enemies’ indirect attacks no longer hit other enemies every frame
Toxic Root no longer spawn an extra root at 0, 0 tile position for the client in online co-op
There should no longer be a chance to get poisoned by rogue, invisible poison clouds in levels that feature them
Uncharted Plateau is no longer under the impression that the level has 2 more enemies than it actually does, now showing the correct amount of enemies in the HUD

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 1.00.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/8e6b1383891aaa29964c284cd7f8f3c4869e1b96.png

Howdy! We're here with our first post-launch MCE patch. It contains mostly fixes and small adjustments to the game. Nothing special, except a few little things to make your mushroom crushing experience more smooth.
We've also made it easier to connect to our official Discord server, so do come by to chat.

MCE Version 1.00.1 - May 27th, 2019

Features: 

There is now a button in the main menu that takes you to our Discord! Find people to play with or just come and have a chat with us!


Adjustments:

Adjusted rank score limits of some of a few later levels
Pressing cancel button no longer closes the equipment menu in co-op when browsing Spell or Trinket lists. Instead it closes the list


Fixes:

Toxic Root + Trinket #5 will no longer end the Spell’s channeling if the front root ends before the back root
Trinket #50 heal timer now resets every time player is no longer next to a destructible level element
Meteor Shower damage no longer resets its status/Trinket modifiers mid cast, so now Trinket #12, #42, and #48’s charge pack the intended punch
Trinket #46’s 2nd positive should now work more reliably
Equipment menu no longer resets to stats view when mouse is not hovering over an item
Fixed Lighting bug on Linux, that made water not illuminate properly
The Steam achievement "8-Ball" should now trigger properly

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 0.97.4
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/cc885f031b42805518ba2b3c544ffbfe9e498453.png

Hey, folks! How's your summer going?
We're putting out a patch with some bug fixes but also few nifty additions Accomplishments, Trinket stats and menus. Check the changelog below for more details.

MCE Version 0.97.4 - August 10th, 2017

Features

Enemy weakness damage is highlighted
Portions of the menu that are not in use, are darkened for clarity
Added a tips section in the beginning of levels to give useful pointers to players
There is a new Accomplishment for destroying Mycelium
New Trinket stat: Recon

Only used by Trinket #37 for the time being
Affects information provided by enemies, such as drops



Adjustments

Menu buttons animate more visibly
Level Select Menu now better indicates if you're missing some levels
Made spell demo entry animation three times faster in Equipment Menu
Players can no longer spam ingame chat with notifications

Notifications now replace the previous one unless certain amount of time has expired or there was a chat message in between

Added more sound effects to enemies' movements
Added some new UI sound effects

Entering pause plays a short jingle and pauses music
Exiting pause, when in online Co-op, plays the same jingle that's played during countdown
Receiving chat messages from other player plays a short beep

Massive buffs to Aqua Sphere
Area of Effect/AoE Spells are now simply called Area Spells
Made Terror's Return a tad easier
Tutorial tutorializes a bit better
Made a couple of Accomplishments less grindy
A few Dictionary updates
A whole slew of Trinket changes


Fixes

Fixed Whirlwind collision detection
Fixed a bug where some longer sound effects would end abruptly
Fixed a bug where menu changes would interrupt chat
Zoom-in and Zoom-out keys no longer work when writing chat messages
Fixed Arven Shrooms collider
Gaia Strikes no longer rumble the controller when in victory menu
Equipment Menu updates bought items properly in Local Co-op
Fixed various Trinket bugs
Fixed UI icons using wrong sprites
Skeletons no longer spam teleport when stunned or jolted
Fixed enemy AI getting stuck if player damaged an enemy from too far away
Skeletons no longer get teleport crazy after knockback or stun
Fixed bug in game HUD where in Local Co-op, Player 2 global cooldown radial would fill the spell icon inaccurately
Fixed Local Co-op damage indicators not showing up for other player when using Split Screen

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 0.97.02
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/3918a7f1256a3fe37c8c395e6bc8335fadac326d.png

Hi, everybody! Summer is here and we are bringing a small patch to warm things up a little. The update contains mostly bug fixes, though, we are also adding a few changes to the Trinkets, enemies' indirect attacks and UI.
 
MCE Version 0.97.2 - June 1st, 2017

Adjustments:

Open and closed menu tabs are now color-coded
Slimes can now be frozen with Deep Freeze
Frozen slimes can then be destroyed with any Spell
Poison Gas vents now have a breaking animation
Fashroom bombs can trigger other Fashroom bombs
Descriptions of Trinkets with multi-line affixes have been made more readable by having the extra lines indented
Trinket #9's specials reworked
Many Trinket affix adjustments

Fixes:

Adjusted some winter levels to make it more difficult to get stuck because of melting ice
Fixed accomplishment rewards

Two different Accomplishments gave the same Trinket as reward
If you already have completed these Accomplishments, the rewards will be fixed for you next time you load your save

Destroyed Slimes are counted in Accomplishments again
Fixed Arvenshrooms getting stuck in some levels
Fixed an end-game Trinket bug specific to Spike Crush
Clones also damage client player in online Co-op
Leaving online multiplayer is possible again
Unequipping Plain Trinkets in local Co-op fixed
Fixed menu navigation for both players in equipment menu when in Co-op mode
Fixed a potential issue with save file sizes
Highscore list now shows online players equipment
Fixed a bug that caused Local Player 2’s Trinkets to be always active outside of Local Co-op
Fixed a bug with Plain and Unique Trinket equips not updating properly in Online Co-op
Fixed an AI bug with Dermshrooms where they were displaying the question mark every time they jumped
Fixed collision on houses’ back walls
Gaia Strikes explosions no longer spawn inside boxes
Fishes swim closer to shore again
Fixed Trinket #41's special effect

Trinket special is now properly randomized

Fixed Peckshrooms kiting AI getting stuck next to stationary enemies
Fixed a bug where in Online Co-op the game would get stuck in loading screen after retrying a level
Fixed Molten Orb’s fragments draw order and collision
Improved level loading times
Fixed a rare bug where Trinket #38's would spawn pickups on ice or snow tiles
Fixed a bug causing HUD Elements to be squished to the left bottom corner of the screen after first time editing any HUD element
Teleport speeds are no longer affected by movement speed bonuses
Fixed an AI bug where aggressive enemies would fail to find a path to a target that was standing still long enough
Trinket #44's special no longer makes spells ignore global cooldown

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Update 0.97.0
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/03cfc0bef4d9fa2615e49b34e27d06f61c4a1ea3.png

Hey, folks! Today we launched MCE 0.97.0, which includes a whole new category of Trinkets - Plain Trinkets.

Aside from those, we added new stats to the Unique Trinkets (a.k.a the old-style Trinkets), some new level visuals and quick-equip function for Spells and Trinkets.

Take a look at our devblog for more details on this update.
Also, last week, we published a hefty blog post, explaining Plain Trinkets in detail.


MCE Version 0.97.0 - April 13th, 2017

Features:

Plain Trinkets

Enemies can now drop Plain Trinkets that have random stat values on them
These trinkets will only get positive stat values
Plain Trinkes quality improves as you progress further in the game
Maximum amount of Plain Trinkets that you can own is 100, but you can sell unwanted Plain Trinkets for 10 spores each
Plain Trinkets will only drop if all of your unlocked Unique Trinkets are collected



Adjustments:

Improved Equipment Menu

You can now quick-equip Spells and Trinkets by hovering over them and holding down casting keys

Removed Camera Zoom from Options menu. Instead, you can use E and Q keys
New Trinket stats affecting each of the 4 enemy resistances individually
Newly plugged in controllers are now detected in runtime
Fixed & updated many dictionary entries and some Trinket descriptions
Adjusted many Unique Trinkets
Added a flashing save indicator to indicate when the game is auto-saving
Added on-screen tooltips for menu controls
Pavement tiles and wells breath new life into some of the levels
Adjusted the first 2 winter levels, making it more difficult to get yourself stuck
Nerfed Strishrooms a little bit


Fixes:

Improved performance of menus
Condition durations stat values are now calculated correctly
Combo bonus stat values are now calculated correctly

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Update 0.96.5
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/39fb210cf9d1c6e554a940efe3adb722e48b47b2.png

Hey-ya! We have just released a new MCE update, introducing HUD adjustment menu. You can now move around, adjust size and remove some interface elements altogether - so, you know, get creative!

The update also contains several Trinket adjustments, new Dictionary entries, some bug fixes and more. Drop by our devblog for more details.

MCE Version 0.96.5 - February 16th, 2017

Features:

HUD Adjustment Menu

Customize the in-game HUD to suit yourself. The menu can be accessed from Options -> Graphics
Move and scale all HUD elements in the game
Toggle ON or OFF various HUD elements, by default some elements are toggled OFF
Change the orientation of values on all HUD elements, for example: changing of collected Spores are shown above, below, left or right from the Spore icon
Anchoring HUD elements

All HUD elements are tied to a specific point on your screen, always staying at a certain distance from that point
You can anchor elements to any corner or side of the screen or even in the center
If the game’s aspect ratio changes due to different resolution settings, all of your HUD elements will follow their anchors




Adjustments

Online Player Health Bar - shows your Co-op partner’s health
Resistances HUD element - shows your current elemental resistances
Movement Speed HUD element - shows current movement speed
Spell Stats HUD element - that shows your Spells’ damage and cooldowns
Vertical Condition Icons HUD element - works like the regular Condition Icons HUD element, but elements are aligned vertically
Added a new basic Trinket stat: post-hit invincibility time

Affects the time Zenon spends invulnerable after getting hit
As a result, Trinket #2's negative special was replaced with this stat
A couple of other Trinkets also get some of their stats replaced with it

Added a couple of new Dictionary entries
Every enemy type now has its own height, so some Spells now miss short targets on lower levels, but hit taller ones
Spore counter font is displayed in yellow color when all spores in the level have been collected
Enemy counter font is displayed in yellow color, when all enemies have been defeated in a combo
ThunderStorm no longer deals extra damage to frozen enemies but still melts them
Trinket #25 now has a special effect
Improved responsiveness of enemy and player damage in Online Co-op for Client player
Some of the more common basic affixes among Trinkets were replaced with rarer ones
The first Trinket drop now unlocks a level earlier

Trinket unlocks in Level 4 instead of Level 5
If you have an existing save file, there is a chance you may be unable to get this trinket, due to this change



Fixes:

Improved the accuracy of all Trinket stats
You can no longer start a game with no Spells equipped
Fixed a bug where Jolting condition wouldn't stun enemies in offline mode
Mad Squirrel now prioritizes closer player or the player it can reach by rolling
Skeleton now prioritizes closest player that it can walk to
Fixed a bug where in Local Co-op, equipment menu would keep unequipped items marked as red
Skeleton behavior fixed when players are invisible

notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/5c6deb93ce0df610e912d48e0b25c1010c8e1d41.png

Ho-ho-howdy, everyone! Winter holidays are almost here, and it means people getting together. And, in the Shroom world, you don’t need to be close to get together anymore, as we’ve just launched Online Co-op mode!

Here's our co-op teaser video:

http://youtu.be/fW7Nq1sRTN8 

In addition to that we’ve also fixed some bugs, made some balance adjustments and (here comes the dessert!) added some special Holiday visuals. Winter Wonderland is in Pratumea (or, at least, some of its parts), enjoy!

You can find more details about the update in our devblog. The full MCE changelog can be found in the dedicated forum thread.

Enjoy the update and Happy Holidays!

MCE Version 0.95.0 - December 20th, 2016

Features:

Online Co-Op

Starting Online Co-op

You can start the Online Co-op mode in Main Menu by pressing on the button in the top left corner of the screen and selecting “Online Co-op”
 You can play in Public mode, where the game will find another player for you by random, or use Friends mode to play with your Steam friends
Selecting the region closest to yours for minimal possible lag. In Public mode you can only join people in the same region. In Friends mode, the region is decided by whoever hosts the game.
Players can chat to each other with the TAB key both in menus and in-game
You can view other players’ equipment from the Equipment Menu


Host Player

In Online mode, one player will act as a host. In Public matchmaking it will usually be the player who started searching first.
In case players have same Spells and Trinkets equipped when joining in Online Co-op, host’s equipment will take priority over the other player.
Only the host can change the level, but both players have to agree to play it by pressing Ready.
Other player can suggest a level to the host by pressing on it in the Level Select menu.
Host cannot select a level that hasn't been unlocked by the other player.

Accomplishments

When in Accomplishment menu, clicking on Accomplishments you have completed lets the other player know of your greatness.
Clicking on Accomplishments you haven't completed lets the other player know that you'd like to attempt completing them.
In Online Co-op, Accomplishments progress differently compared to Local Co-Op.

Most Accomplishments are counted individually for each player
For example: When you defeat an enemy with LV1 Fireball, only you will progress towards the 'We BURN!' Accomplishment
Some Accomplishments still require cooperation from both players, for example, beating a level with Fire spells only requires that BOTH players only equip Fire pells.


Loot in Online Co-op

Both players have their own private loot dropped on the ground, not visible for the other player. Health Extracts are the only exception
Collected Spores and Trinkets are not shared!
Enemies defeated by both players can drop Spores and Trinkets.



Adjustments:

Updated several dictionary entries
Adjusted all boss Spore drops
Lowered Frozen Lagoon's difficulty a little bit
Lowered some spell cooldowns & damages
Some slight Trinket balancing
Special Holiday visuals added to the game

Fixes:

Every stacked pick-up now counts towards the Hoarder Accomplishment

Hello, crushers! We've put out a couple of small patches during this first week on Steam. Just fixes and adjustments, with the first actual feature update coming in next Thursday, October 20th. 

You can keep tabs on the whole changelog on our changelog thread. We also wrote a short blog post about some happenings since the release.

MCE Version 0.80.4 - October 13th, 2016

Adjustments

"Up Direction" setting in the Control Options menu is now called "Movement"
Movement" setting has 3 options:

Mode A: Move northeast by pressing up movement key
Mode B: Move northwest by pressing up movement key
Mode C: You have to press movement keys diagonally to move. (This option is recommended for controllers only)

Adjusted Trinket drop chances (mostly increased by roughly 10%)
Adjusted accomplishment visibility requirements
Made it slightly easier to upgrade level 1 spells to level 2 (accomplishments now require 35 enemies to be defeated instead of 40)
Replaced a Strishroom in Terror's Return with a Dermshroom to make the level a tad easier
Lowered a couple of spell cooldowns
Small Level Select UI adjustment

Fixes

Menu navigation with controller and keyboard in level selection, accomplishments and options menus has been improved
Level Select menu properly highlights previously selected level
Charmed enemies that have been aggro'd, no longer keep their aggro on the player
Cleaned up Skeleton sprites
Various trinket fixes



MCE Version 0.80.1 - October 5th, 2016

Fixes

Fixed an issue where OpenGL version (MAC & Linux) was releasing Render Textures that were still in use, when changing resolution or fullscreen mode.
Fixed an issue where the game would change resolution on launch every time, causing screen to blink black at start.
Several minor Trinket effects were fixed.
Disabled controller rumble in Main Menu.

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 0.80.4
notes.notes:
Hello, crushers! We've put out a couple of small patches during this first week on Steam. Just fixes and adjustments, with the first actual feature update coming in next Thursday, October 20th. 

You can keep tabs on the whole changelog on our changelog thread. We also wrote a short blog post about some happenings since the release.

MCE Version 0.80.4 - October 13th, 2016

Adjustments

"Up Direction" setting in the Control Options menu is now called "Movement"
Movement" setting has 3 options:

Mode A: Move northeast by pressing up movement key
Mode B: Move northwest by pressing up movement key
Mode C: You have to press movement keys diagonally to move. (This option is recommended for controllers only)

Adjusted Trinket drop chances (mostly increased by roughly 10%)
Adjusted accomplishment visibility requirements
Made it slightly easier to upgrade level 1 spells to level 2 (accomplishments now require 35 enemies to be defeated instead of 40)
Replaced a Strishroom in Terror's Return with a Dermshroom to make the level a tad easier
Lowered a couple of spell cooldowns
Small Level Select UI adjustment

Fixes

Menu navigation with controller and keyboard in level selection, accomplishments and options menus has been improved
Level Select menu properly highlights previously selected level
Charmed enemies that have been aggro'd, no longer keep their aggro on the player
Cleaned up Skeleton sprites
Various trinket fixes



MCE Version 0.80.1 - October 5th, 2016

Fixes

Fixed an issue where OpenGL version (MAC & Linux) was releasing Render Textures that were still in use, when changing resolution or fullscreen mode.
Fixed an issue where the game would change resolution on launch every time, causing screen to blink black at start.
Several minor Trinket effects were fixed.
Disabled controller rumble in Main Menu.
